blocks.html:
This method retrieves the rules of a promotion. It can be the promotion's rules,
or its application method's buy or target rules. That depends on the rule type
you specify as a parameter.

This method sends a request to the
[List Rules of a Promotion API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#promotions\_getpromotionsidrule\_type)

types.name: ruleType
types.description: The type of rules to retrieve. Can be `rules`, `buy-rules`, or `target-rules`.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the rules.

children.name: promotion_type
children.description: The type of promotion to retrieve the attributes for.

children.name: application_method_type
children.description: The type of application method to retrieve the attributes for.

children.name: application_method_target_type
children.description: The target type of application method to retrieve the attributes for.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: attribute
children.description: The attribute to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.

children.name: operator
children.description:
The operator used to check whether the buy rule applies on a cart.
For example, `eq` means that the cart's value for the specified attribute
must match the specified value.

children.name: values
children.description: The values to compare against when checking whether a promotion can be applied on a cart.
